description: Payer-focused healthcare analytics agent for revenue cycle management. Answers questions about claim denials, appeal outcomes, collection rates, days-in-AR, PMPM, payer mix, prescription cost splits (payer-paid vs patient copay), and at-risk revenue. Queries 16 curated gold-layer tables including payer-exclusive aggregates (agg_days_in_ar, agg_appeal_outcomes). Does NOT cover provider productivity (RVU, panel size, board certification) — use the ProviderAgent for those.
